_about: Look and sound for every stage. Changing anything here marks all assets and scenes for redo.

fonts.headline: Fredoka Bold, or the nearest bold rounded sans available
fonts.body: Inter SemiBold, or the nearest clean sans available
fonts.ui_mockups: Inter or the system sans, so screens look like a real chat app

text_rules.on_screen_text_position: upper third, centred, inside the safe margin
text_rules.captions: bottom centre, 44 px, light text on a 70% black rounded box, max 2 lines of 42 characters

motion_rules: Ease in-out on everything; pops and stamps take 0.25-0.35 s.
Hold every on-screen text line for at least 2 seconds.
No strobing: any flicker stays below 3 flashes per second.
Each scene starts when its voiceover paragraph starts.
Action icons always appear in their action colour, inside a circular badge.
art_direction: Flat, friendly cartoon. Simple round avatars with dot eyes only. Night scenes are dark navy, not scary.
brand_rules: Chat screens look like a modern chat app (dark sidebar, channel list, messages) but never use the Discord logo, wordmark or mascot.
The narration may say 'Discord'; the visuals stay generic.
Only the example names from game.json appear on screen.

audio.voice: Calm and slightly dramatic, like a late-night radio host. 48 kHz mono WAV, one file per scene.
audio.music: Low, tense, royalty-free background beat, about 15-20 dB under the voice. Cuts out at the drumroll in scene 13, back for scene 14.
audio.final_loudness: about -16 LUFS integrated, peaks below -1 dBTP

export.scene_clips: 1920x1080, 30 fps, no audio, exactly the scene's duration_s
export.final: H.264 MP4, 1920x1080, 30 fps, high quality (CRF about 18); AAC 48 kHz 192 kbps stereo; captions burned in
